class.name: IfcBoundingBox
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A box domain is an orthogonal box parallel to the axes of the geometric coordinate system which may be used to limit the domain of a half space solid. A box domain is specified by the coordinates of the bottom left corner, and the lengths of the sides measured in the directions of the coordinate axes. Every semantic object having a physical extent might have

members.member: Location of the bottom left corner (having the minimum values).
Length attribute (measured along the edge parallel to the X Axis)
Width attribute (measured along the edge parallel to the Y Axis)
Height attribute (measured along the edge parallel to the Z Axis).
